The '''Belgaroth asteroid field''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Belgaroth system/Legends|Belgaroth system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], between the first two [[Orbit/Legends|orbits]] of the star system and its outer planets.<ref name="CatCW" />
